root_cause: Initial seven-domain scenario studio displayed one metric at a time and did not provide a portfolio-wide evidence and observed Brain operational comparison. Platform forecast counts can be confused with tenant-approved customer predictions.
prevention: Allow portfolio scenario comparison only from observed customer historical metrics; distinguish independent what-if assumptions, unknown data, recent authenticated Brain runtime observations and unverified Heartbeat history. Never aggregate mixed units or infer causal uplift.

evidence.scope: Single existing V2 scenario studio, additive read-only derived UI, no Supabase mutation
evidence.model_validation: Not independent backtesting or numeric cross-domain calibration
